formattedAddress: 106, Taiwan, Taipei City, Da’an District, Ren'ai Village, Lane 27, Section 4, Ren'ai Rd, 25號12F

text.text: I stayed at the Kimpton Da An Hotel and had breakfast at The Tavernist every morning — it was fantastic! The food was fresh and delicious, and the team was genuinely warm, attentive, and full of positive energy. You can really feel their great teamwork and hospitality. A wonderful way to start the day! Highly recommended.

text.text: I came her with my girlfriend and another couple for a nice dinner in Taipei. We ordered the set menu as well as two pork main dishes. The food was fine, but for the price, it is not even close to being worth it. Our bill was $350 USD for four people which by Taipei standards is pretty insane. It's a nice hotel, but I would never recommend anyone to spend their $$$ here.

text.text: I spent a night there, during reservation I wasn’t clearly informed that only a fixed set dinner was available, which was a bit disappointing. The food overall was tasteless, with the exception of the sea bass and beef. The waitstaff introduced each dish very quietly, and even with full attention it was very difficult to hear them. Overall, the experience was fair, but given the relatively high price, it didn’t feel like good value for money.

text.text:
The Food: The Servers, particularly Lyn had recommended us the lunch set and walked us through the choices. She set the expectations and the food blew us away. The ribeye was literally melt in my mouth. The seafood was fresh and perfectly cooked. The dessert was to die for. It was an excellently curated by the chef.

The Service: This is what separates a good restaurant from an excellent restaurant. I highly commend Lyn for the excellent service. She was very attentive to our needs and was very funny as well. She takes EXCELLENT photos. She also asked us where we're from and how long we'll be staying in Taiwan. She even gave us recommendations in Taiwan. Her service is unmatched. Big props to Lyn for making our time there very delightful.

The atmospehere: The restaurant was situated on the 12th floor. It has good views. But an insider tip that Lyn told us, there's a part on the balcony that has Taipei101 as the backdrop. The lighting of the place really set the mood. It screams a mix of hominess and luxury. Only good interior designers can do that. Big props to the atmosphere as well.
